data.revised_prompt:
Create a clean polished 2D game FX sprite sheet on a solid #FF00FF background. Exactly 2 rows by 2 columns, four animation frames arranged in a 2x2 grid. Use the provided guide only for cell placement, spacing, and centering; do NOT draw any guide lines, borders, labels, safe-area marks, or any grid overlay. Each frame must be centered in its cell, consistent scale, and fully contained within the central 65% of each cell with nothing crossing cell edges.

Effect: a universal special-card trigger effect, elegant and readable at small card size, a white starflower bloom made of slender radial light petals.

Frame 1 (top-left): a tiny white star point at center, subtle glow only.
Frame 2 (top-right): eight to twelve fine white-gold beams opening like flower petals from the center.
Frame 3 (bottom-left): full clean starflower chrysanthemum, bright center, thin halo, subtle gold accents on the beams, refined and symmetrical.
Frame 4 (bottom-right): beams fading into white glints and a very soft halo, delicate and minimal.

Style constraints: effect only, no playing card, no explosion, no fire, no smoke, no fragments, no tearing, no UI, no text, no icons. Crisp HD polished card-game effect, soft glow, luminous white with gentle gold highlights, centered composition, clean edges.
